standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 6470-6473)
standard_prerequisites.use: Realises the base-changed stack as a quotient in order to compute the diagonal.

core_obligations: (1): base change the gerbe along a smooth presentation of the base, compute the inertia by the fibre product formula, note that the base change is again a gerbe so that its inertia is flat and locally of finite presentation by the characterization, and descend these properties back along the flat finitely presented cover (proof lines 6454-6466)

(2): with the same notation, realise the base-changed stack as a quotient by a flat group space, observe that the diagonal of the base change is the base change of the original diagonal, and check surjectivity, flatness and local finite presentation for the quotient, where the quotient morphism and the group are available with exactly those properties (proof lines 6467-6516)
proof_roadmap: (1)：取 Y → Y 满光滑，X' = X ×_Y Y；由惯性在基变换下的纤维积描述与下降引理，只需证 I_{X'} → X' 平坦且局部有限表现；而 X' 仍是 gerbe ⇒ 由惯性刻画即得。
(2)：设 X' = [Y/G]（G 在 Y 上平坦且局部有限表现）；Δ 的基变换就是 Δ'，只需证 Δ' 满、平坦、局部有限表现，即 [Y/G] → [Y/G] ×_Y [Y/G] 的性质，由 G 与商映射的平坦性、局部有限表现性与满性即得。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a gerbe over a base the inertia is flat and locally of finite presentation, and its diagonal is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 6428-6452, label lemma-gerbe-isom-fppf). The proof (source lines 6454-6517) base changes along a smooth presentation of the base, applies the fibre product description of the inertia and the descent statements to reduce to the base-changed gerbe, where the characterization of gerbes by their inertia applies, and then computes the diagonal of a quotient presentation by a flat group space (proof lines 6454-6516). The two reductions and the quotient computation are the substance. H3.
